slides_data.text: Fix the entry level hiring in Tech.  College grads should be able to apply and train OJT for entry level jobs in tech.  No certifications, no STEM degree or certification is required.  We don’t require them in the military.  High school graduates can go from 0 to functional in the military in six months and that is only because they are learning multiple career paths.  Tech companies are pretending college grads can’t do the job because they lack the necessary “certification and experience” but the reality is the aren’t required at all.  The only want to use it as an excuse for H1B.
